messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty alert fired — service=inference-gateway-prod; symptom=error_rate_5xx_high; region=eu-west1; rate=520/min; threshold=200/min; PD incident=P-3742. Autopage engaged.

devon_oncall: acked P-3742 @pagerbot — I'm on it. quick check, is this region-wide or a single AZ?

observability-bot: grafana link: https://grafana.company/r/inference-gateway?orgId=1&from=now-30m&to=now — 5xx spike started ~4198765200, concurrent connections +40%.

lee_sre: seeing 502/504 dominating, not 500s. tcp resets up on front proxy too. suspect upstream worker saturation / KV cache churn.

maria_infra: checking node metrics — eu-west1-worker pool has 3 nodes reporting OOM kills in last 10m, memory pressure high on model-worker pods.

devon_oncall: ok, can we route traffic away from eu-west1 while we triage? what's risk to customers?

carla_prod: customer-impact: webhook customers in EU reporting failed requests and increased errors in SLO dashboard. Estimated ~8% of active calls affected in last 10m. PS: support already triaged a few enterprise customers.

pd-bot: PagerDuty P-3742 acknowledged by devon_oncall at 4198765445. Escalation path: oncall->sre->eng-infra.

lee_sre: temporary mitigation plan: 1) scale inference-worker replicas in eu-west1 +2 2) enable fallback model routing for non-critical traffic 3) warm KV cache on extra nodes. Executing scale now.

maria_infra: running:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-workers-eu --replicas=12
kubectl -n prod get pods -o wide | grep inference-worker-eu
```
started at 4198765460.

devon_oncall: applying route policy to send low-priority requests to fallback-small-7b for 10m. Config snippet:
```
route-policy: {
  match: path =~ "/embed|/noncritical",
  action: route_to: fallback-small-7b-eu
}
```

devon_oncall: disabled keepalive pooling on frontend for eu-west1 for short window to reduce connection reuse pressure.

observability-bot: KV cache eviction rate dropped after scaling, 5xx rate down to 180/min in last 90s (below alert threshold). https://grafana.company/r/shortlink

carla_prod: support: sending proactive notices to affected customers; marking incident P-3742 as "investigating customer impact".

lee_sre: looking at pod logs, we saw repeated OOMKilled on model-worker due to unexpected spike in context length during a canary test (large batch). I've flagged the canary job and paused it.

maria_infra: nodes recovered after scale + drain of 2 pods onto new replicas. no further OOMs in last 4 minutes.

devon_oncall: good. PD: are we safe to close autopage? I'd like to keep traffic policy in place for another 10m and watch.

pd-bot: P-3742 status: acknowledged -> monitoring. Next update due by 4198765889 if no change.

lee_sre: postmortem notes to collect: canary test scheduling overlap, autoscaler threshold tuning, memory limit for model-worker, improved circuit-breaker to fallback variant earlier. tagging eng-runtime + eng-ml.

carla_prod: customer comms draft in #support-drafts, will send once stable for 15m.

devon_oncall: checkin: 5xx baseline back under threshold for 6m. keeping routing rule for 10m more then revert. leaving incident open for follow-up. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: Incident P-3742 - monitoring. If 5xx rate rises above threshold again, will repage.

lee_sre: follow-ups assigned: - eng-runtime to add guardrail for canary batch sizes - infra to tweak pod memory requests - product to review fallback routing policy. I'll create the postmortem doc and ping the groups.

carla_prod: noted, will coordinate customer updates after postmortem.

devon_oncall: end of live thread — will hand off to oncall rotation for follow-up. leaving channel.
